critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/routes/growth_analytics.py: _region_segments correctly computes mobile_pct and signup_page_rate_pct and skips self-referrers. Clean, no _id leak.

/app/frontend/src/lib/region.js: currentRegion() unconditionally calls localStorage.removeItem('miracurl_region') on every read — fine for correctness but a tiny perf drag on hot paths; cheap enough to ignore.

/app/frontend/src/pages/SignupSalon.jsx: switchTo() mutates state + rememberRegion, and a useEffect replaces the URL via history.replaceState — in-place switch verified to preserve window globals and typed form data. Nicely done.
UsLanding.jsx hero padding (pb-44 sm:pb-56) + sticky bar at bottom only on <sm — verified on 390×844 viewport.
